File surface: + `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAgents.ts` and its test, + `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useAiSurface.ts` (already edited at 868742bf). Reason: the dev's report 7217346137 measured that `useAiSurfaceEnabled`'s loading latch never clears when `useAgents` serves an empty catalog from its module cache, so the gate cannot ship without an additive "fetch settled" signal from `useAgents`. The same defect leaves a seat-less member on the `ai:chat` page's loading state on a direct link; it is fixed in this PR and recorded under its Acceptance notes, not filed separately (option A of the report, PM discretion: the fix is the gate's prerequisite).
Serial constraints cleared: overlap-check on the branch plus `useAgents.ts` exit 0 against origin/main 73d5e347f7; shares `useAiSurface.ts` with #37924 (os-tesla, draft), merges cleanly.
